name: hash keyword defaults
source:
def sample(z: Hash[:a, 1], a:)
 [z, a]
end
p sample(a: 2)

expected.off:
def sample(z: Hash[:a, 1], a:)
 [z, a]
end
p sample(a: 2)
expected.safe:
def sample(z: Hash[:a, 1], a:)
 [z, a]
end
p sample(a: 2)
expected.all:
def sample(z: {:a => 1}, a:)
 [z, a]
end
p sample(a: 2)

name: hash conversion with enumerator
source:
pairs = [[:a, 1], [:b, 2]]
seen = []
p Hash[pairs.each.with_index { |pair| seen << pair }]
p seen

expected.off:
pairs = [[:a, 1], [:b, 2]]
seen = []
p Hash[pairs.each.with_index { |pair| seen << pair }]
p seen
expected.safe:
pairs = [[:a, 1], [:b, 2]]
seen = []
p Hash[pairs.each { |pair| seen << pair }]
p seen
expected.all:
pairs = [[:a, 1], [:b, 2]]
seen = []
p pairs.each { |pair| seen << pair }.to_h
p seen

name: singleton keyword defaults
source:
module Demo
 def self::sample(z: 1, a:)
  [Hash[:z, z], a]
 end
end
p Demo.sample(a: 2)

expected.off:
module Demo
 def self::sample(z: 1, a:)
  [Hash[:z, z], a]
 end
end
p Demo.sample(a: 2)
expected.safe:
module Demo
 def self.sample(a:, z: 1)
  [Hash[:z, z], a]
 end
end
p Demo.sample(a: 2)
expected.all:
module Demo
 def self.sample(a:, z: 1)
  [{:z => z}, a]
 end
end
p Demo.sample(a: 2)

name: with object empty parameter nested
redis spy and hash conversion
source:
class Spy
 attr_reader :calls
 def initialize; @calls = []; end
 def setex(key, expiry, value); @calls << [key, expiry, value]; end
 def set(key, value, ex:); @calls << [key, ex, value]; end
end
spy = Spy.new
value = Hash[:a, 1]
spy.setex("key", 3, value)
p spy.calls
